body:
A Classic Vanilla Server!
=========================

Ever wanted to just play Minecraft?

Looking for a server with
clean chat, simple survival,
and support for your
client-side mods?

Then you've come to
the right place!

=========================

Rules:
- No swearing or curse words.
  
- Be nice to other players.

- dont spam the chat.

- dont break any houses or builds.

- share items.

- Have fun!

=========================

Info:

Server Owner: classiccatlinux

Supported Versions: 1.12.2 - 26.2
